caseName: Securities & Exchange Commission v. New England Electric System
caseNameFull: Securities and Exchange Commission v. New England Electric System
attorneys: George Spiegel and Worth Row-ley on the motions., John R. Quarles, Richard B. Dunn, Richard W. Southgate and John J. Glessner III for respondents in opposition.

opinions.text:
C. A. 1st Cir. (Certiorari granted, ante, p. 816.) Motion of Municipal Electric Association of Massachusetts for leave to file a brief, as amicus curiae, granted. Its motion to present oral argument, as amicus curiae, denied.

Mr. Justice Marshall took no part in the consideration or decision of this matter.
